Cued: far contra +0.26 acute (4 / 4), then -0.06 n.s. / -0.28 [-0.39, -0.14] (4 / 4, ipsilesional chronically); close ipsi +0.31 acute (4 / 4), +0.14 chronic n.s. (3 / 4); close mid +0.20 and far ipsi +0.17 acute (4 / 4). SIGN: + = READ more contralesional than the lick landed (decoder like-for-like offset, a DIRECTION quantity; page sign-conventions box); landing / decoded lateral position + = contralesional; image left = ipsilesional. Decoder: frozen pre-stroke KEY-row lateral lick-position decoder per lick set (z-scored Allen areas with the ALM / tjM1 split, lags 0-0.2 s, August pre sessions, pre scored leave-one-session-out). Licks: LP video licks (cam4 detector) with 3-D tongue position from cam1 + cam4 pose. LIKE-FOR-LIKE offset = each lick's decoded lateral position minus a Gaussian-weighted mean (sigma 0.1 mm, chosen by held-out pre prediction) of the decoded positions of the animal's PRE licks of the same set that LANDED at the same lateral place (any spout, no bins); 0.1-2.1 % of licks without a reference (most in acute cued). Session means; change vs pre, 95 % paired nested bootstrap (animals -> sessions), * = CI excludes 0, k/n animals. PROVISIONAL (n = 4).
